query:
SELECT searchId, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN enrichmentStatus = 'failed' AND apolloId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_no_apollo,
  SUM(CASE WHEN enrichmentStatus = 'failed' AND apolloId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_has_apollo,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '') AND enrichmentStatus != 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as incomplete_not_failed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '') AND enrichmentStatus = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as incomplete_and_failed
FROM companies WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003)
GROUP BY searchId;
